mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1300 units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1300, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 4.2% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 in a month, the combined signal of a strong labor market boosts S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and stock performance
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals a supply-side boost, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as productivity gains support earnings growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when INDPRO > 6-month MA are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the GDP annual growth rate (GDPC1) below 2% signals a potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
evidence_refs: fact:historical GDP and stock market correlation
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 55% of instances when GDPC1 < 2%, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is below its 12-month moving average, the combined signal of tight monetary policy and low inflation leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a single month signals a labor market shock, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days, as investors react to the surprise.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market shocks and stock reactions
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE increases > 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months, indicating strong consumer demand, supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as retail sector performance boosts the broader market.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when RSAFS increases for 3 months are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
